NOT launched, NOT chained.] FALLBACK (no stocktarget): r1-r8 + r9g -- the 16-fuel floor in the iron-ladder fallback and the peaceful sword switch in the room order's deposit plan; NO walk to the junk well (stocktarget-only). Both engines APPROVE the fallback delta (10-12). The read (md5 8a22256f) is valid without stocktarget: no gate reads a stocktarget row; its well-walk counts read zero here. THE CHANGE: readyFor asks the craft skill's own room check (skills.mjs craftRouteFor mirrors craftLevel's route A/B/C; chainPeak over its steps; the pickup slot held as admitRoom holds it; the craft's own wear-out route counted in tools). With no room there is no craft order and the prompt stops advertising the craft; the remedy the craft would name becomes the order: eat (a single food, hunger < 20), deposit X (admission's own depositDue/bankClosed; X frees a stack, is no craft ingredient, and is chosen outside the iron ladder first), or home when far from any usable chest and only toward a deposit that can run -- never a placement. A remedy the gate's memory would refuse is skipped (AdmissionControl.memoryRefuses, a read). Outcomes are measured (slots before/after); a remedy that freed nothing backs off 10 min; an interruption is free. An unknown verdict (an ambiguous route, a pickup-only shortage, a simulation miss) issues the craft as before, tagged "(room via unknown)". Rows only this build writes: _craft_noroom, _room_order. Paper (sandbox4, 10-12): candidate far = home -> town_deposit -> craft; kept = home -> build_well -> deposit raw_iron -> craft; room = craft at once; control far/kept never crafted (no-room x3, refused cooldown x12-14 in 180 s).

own_lines.note: C1: rung craft orders the room check PASSED that then failed for no room (wear/unknown counted apart), >= 3 and > 0.2 x the control rate. Dry run on the base build: fires (the population is visible).
C2: a deposit room order that lost anything but its X beyond what the walk/recovery spends (chest; logs/planks < 16; scaffold < 8; tools; food; never sticks); +more = breach.
C5: > 10% of canary room orders refused at admission (memoryRefuses should keep it ~0).
C6: a home room order issued within 96 of the origin (admission's own distance; farFromBank).
CATASTROPHE: canary POST rung craft successes = 0 while the expected count (PRE rate x POST bot-h x control ratio) >= 5.
Poisson P(observed <= expected) < 0.05 for canary POST rung craft successes. BLOCKS KEEP (INCONCLUSIVE).
Room order -> that craft within 15 min below 25% of >= 5 judged episodes. BLOCKS KEEP (INCONCLUSIVE).
Crafts issued on an unknown room failing for no room above 0.2 x the control no-room rate (C1's blind spot). BLOCKS KEEP (INCONCLUSIVE).
POSITIVE CONTROL: refused rung craft orders visible in the control. BLOCKS KEEP.
POSITIVE CONTROL: no-room craft failures visible in the control. BLOCKS KEEP.
